Mr. T. K. Jha, counsel for the applicants.
Mr. Kashif Shakeel, Dy. A.G. for the State/respondent.
Mr. C. P. Lahrey, Counsel for the Objector.
Heard on I.A.No.01/2022, Application for Grant of Ad-interim bail.

The applicants have been arrested in connection with Crime No.287/2022 registered in police station Baradwar, District Sakti, CG for offence punishable under Sections 376, 506, 147 of IPC &
Section 6 of POCSO Act.

Learned counsel for the applicants submits that applicants are the relatives of main accused Hirendra Khunte, against whom allegation of sexual intercourse for almost 7 years are there and he has already been granted regular bail by the trial Court on the ground that prosecutrix has given no objection for granting bail and also on merits.
He further submits that present applicants are only of the relatives of the main accused and they are roped in the offence unnecessarily.
He submits that applicants No.4 and 5 are students, therefore, their application may be considered for interim bail till final disposal.

Counsel for the State opposes the application and submits that there is serious allegation of assault upon the present applicants and it has also come in impugned order that bail was obtained from Hirendra Khunte by assuring to the prosecutrix that he will marry her, but present applicants are in different footing, therefore, they are not entitled for interim bail.

Counsel for the objector also opposes the application and submits that prosecutrix was subjected to Durgeshwar Khuntey vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/113122504/
1 commit sexual intercourse by main accused Hirendra Khunte for last 7 years and thereafter refused to marry her but the allegation against the present applicants is that they have assaulted her,
therefore, their application may be rejected.
Having heard counsel for the parties and having regard to factual situation of the case, considering the fact that main accused has been granted regular bail by trial Court, at this stage, I am inclined to allow the application for grant of Ad-interim bail to the applicants.
Accordingly, the application I.A.No.01/2022 is allowed.
